---
description: Produce the technical design (design.md) for a feature spec
agent: star-designer
---

Produce the technical design for the feature named in the user's message. Read `specs/<feature>/requirements.md` and `specs/<feature>/openapi.yaml`, then follow the designer procedure: ask about architectural decisions the spec leaves open, and write `specs/<feature>/design.md` (architecture, layering, data flow, key decisions, NFRs). Present the key decisions to the user for confirmation. Do not write any code or change the spec.
